description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class KpiSearchFilterParams used for filtering KPI search results, including setting and getting a job title ID and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: KpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for KPI search filter parameters, extending general filter parameters and adding specific KPI filtering options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets default sort field to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the current job title ID filter value.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter value.
